_comment: mcpo config (C:\AI\mcpo\config.json). start-mcpo.ps1 serves it as OpenAPI on 127.0.0.1:8100 with --api-key <MCPO_API_KEY from C:\AI\mcpo\api-key.txt>. In Open WebUI: Settings > Tools > add http://127.0.0.1:8100/gw with Bearer <MCPO_API_KEY>. Merge this server into the existing mcpServers block.
